note: The weekly loop's challengers (fast path, 21 Nov 2026).

candidates.test: the hook and title promise something hidden and name its kind without a figure ('What's hidden under Paris? A city of the dead.' / 'What's Hidden Under Derinkuyu?') against the champion's plain 'What's under <place>? Let's go down.'
candidates.why: From The Ground Up (81.3K subs) gets 16M (hidden room), 1.7M (secret hideout), 1.4M (secret bunker) and 1.3M (underground city) on secret/hidden promises; its median Short on the channel page is ~1M vs Cutaway Instinct's (21.7K subs) 10-50K on plain engineering 'why' titles. In tonight's searches the top Derinkuyu/Catacombs Shorts (2.5M, 1.8M) and Cutaway's 'secret' arena/bunker hits all promise a hidden thing. No figure in the title, so the payoff rule holds. Research 2026-11-23 (Monday, hooks): the biggest dive-shaped Shorts tonight all promise what is at the bottom, not how deep: 'Russia drilled the deepest hole on Earth and what was inside it is terrifying' 12M, 'Catacombs of Paris are bigger than you think' 2.4M on an 824-subscriber channel, 'They Found Secret Tunnels Under the City… Then Discovered THIS' 772K on 66K. Our three published titles are 'How Deep Does X Go?' (436, 424, 263 views in the first 1-2 days, no retention yet). Test wording: 'What's at the Bottom of <Place>?' / hook 'What's hidden under <place>?'.

candidates.test: frame 1 already falling through the street surface (motion from frame 1) against the champion's still landmark shot
candidates.why: the sample opens on a still facade for ~2.5 s; a dive already moving may stop more swipes

candidates.test: a 1 s pull-back showing the whole stack right after the hook, then layer by layer, against the champion's pull-back only at the payoff
candidates.why: showing the depth to come may hold viewers through the middle

candidates.test: a title with the deepest figure against the question title ('What's Under Grand Central?')
candidates.why: Cutaway Instinct's hits use the question; a figure may stop more scrollers

candidates.test: a train rumble and station hum on each tunnel layer against whooshes only
candidates.why: sound that matches the layer may hold after the hook
